$doc: SHARD-PLATFORM SF47-g: Pine Hollow's four midpoint entries (G93 / G99 / G103 / G131) walked edge -> shard and back on the live world (Pine's runtime terrain, trees, props and colliders, the engine's entry sockets). The bake holds each canyon gap flat at y = 0 across +-10.8 m for 45 m in, then the entry road ramps onto the trail. Pine cannot be walked in the grid yet (liveSession refuses a cell with a runtime source until its hybrid admission, M3), so this standalone walk is the proof. layout.ts's road names are swapped on x (W_ROAD runs at x = +250): the legs name the compass edge. Run: scripts/browser-lane.sh node scripts/physics-baseline.mjs --no-build --mode=walk --shard=pine-hollow --route=progress/shard-platform/sf47/entries-route.json --url=<served build>
